Given that f(x,y,z)=y2z2+xz, find ∂f∂z, where (x,y,z) are Cartesian coordinates and (r,θ,z) are the corresponding cylindrical polar coordinates.

a
 2r2zcos2⁡θ+sin⁡θ
b
r(sin2⁡θ+cos⁡θ)
c
 2z+r2cos2⁡θ
d
 r2cos⁡θ+sin2⁡θ
e
2r2zsin2⁡θ+rcos⁡θ
